title: Console plugin bundle
what: The bundle's declaration, manifest, Nuxt layer configuration and host declarations, its language pack, and the packed bundle a console extends at /remote, under client/.

title: IronRDP backend build
what: The script that builds and vendors IronRDP's web client at a pinned commit, and the rewrite that un-bases its inlined WebAssembly before the console's build, in client/scripts and the vendored package.

title: Console relay calls
what: The screen's calls through the console's relay base: route paths and socket addresses, refusal codes read in the bundle's language pack, and the wire types the screen reads, in service.ts, refusals.ts and shared/remote.ts.
